cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the sentence, so it takes nominative case.
After потомки (descendants), the genitive case shows possession.
The direct object of родила (bore) takes accusative case.
The preposition на (on/upon) in the context of marriage governs instrumental case.
After с (with), the genitive case expresses accompaniment.
The phrase в глазах (in the eyes/sight) with genitive expresses perspective.
After отцом (father), the genitive case shows the child relationship.
The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

reading.question: What is being listed at the beginning?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states Вот сыновья Израиля (Here are the sons of Israel).

reading.question: Whose family line is being traced?
reading.explain: The section header Сыновья Иуды (Sons of Judah) indicates the genealogy of Judah.

reading.ru: Ир, первенец Иуды, делал зло в глазах Господа.
reading.question: What is said about Er, Judah's firstborn?
options: He did evil in the sight of the Lord
He was righteous in the sight of the Lord
He was a king over Israel
reading.correct: He did evil in the sight of the Lord
reading.explain: The text states делал зло в глазах Господа (did evil in the sight of the Lord).

reading.ru: Фомар, невестка Иуды, родила ему Пареца и Зераха.
reading.question: Who bore Perez and Zerah?
reading.explain: The text names Фомар, невестка Иуды (Tamar, daughter-in-law of Judah) as the mother.

reading.ru: Всего у Иуды было пятеро сыновей.
reading.question: How many sons did Judah have in total?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states пятеро сыновей (five sons).

reading.ru: Сыновья Зераха — Зимри, Етан, Ямал, Халкол и Дара.
reading.question: How many sons did Zerah have?
reading.explain: The text lists Зимри, Етан, Ямал, Халкол и Дара - five names.
